tools.name: get_listing_details
tools.description: Look up a property listing by its MLS number and return its price, address, status, and basic features.

params.name: mls_number
params.description: MLS identifier of the listing, e.g. 'MLS-1048213'

tools.name: update_listing_price
tools.description: Looks up a listing's current asking price and then changes it to the new price, recording the change in the listing's price history.

params.name: reason
params.description: Short reason for the price change

tools.name: charge_listing_promotion_fee
tools.description: Charges the agent's saved card for a featured-placement promotion on a listing for a number of days.

params.name: mls_number
params.description: MLS identifier of the listing to promote

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the listing agent

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days to feature the listing (1-30)

tools.name: run_comps_report
tools.description: Runs the comparable-sales analysis script for a listing and returns the script's exit status and output.

params.name: mls_number
params.description: MLS identifier of the listing to analyze

params.name: radius_miles
params.description: Search radius for comparable sales in miles
